Azure Government note: DAX Studio is marked Verify for Gov. Validate workstation policy, external tool usage, Service connectivity, and XMLA endpoint settings before making it required for delivery.

When DAX Studio is available:
1. Open Power BI Desktop with this file, then launch DAX Studio from External Tools.
2. Connect to the local model (DAX Studio auto-detects the open session).
3. Copy the query behind the card below from Performance Analyzer (right-click > Copy query) and paste it into DAX Studio.
4. Run with Server Timings enabled and review Formula Engine (FE) vs Storage Engine (SE) time, and the query plan.
5. Re-run after simplifying a measure (for example, comparing 'Margin Health Score (Unoptimized)' vs 'Margin Health Score' from Lab 02 Exercise 8) and compare SE/FE splits.

Alternate path when DAX Studio is unavailable: rely on Performance Analyzer's DAX query time column and compare it before/after a measure rewrite using the same visual and filter context, as done in Exercise 1 and Exercise 4.

Expected takeaway: DAX Studio adds Storage Engine/Formula Engine visibility that Performance Analyzer does not expose, but Performance Analyzer alone is sufficient to detect and compare relative optimization wins.
